subject: Sparrow RFP: request for evaluation credits and benchmark access
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sparrow.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Sparrow is running a four-vendor RFP to pick a low-latency inference provider for our conversational assistant. Teams involved are product, procurement, and infra.

To run a fair head-to-head benchmark we'll need:
- 2 weeks of dedicated eval access to a production-like model endpoint (up to 1M tokens)
- a token credit or invoice cap for usage (targeting ~$12k equivalent)
- access to basic logs for latency/throughput reporting (redacted PII ok)

Can Redwood provide a trial credit package and a short statement of terms we can include in the RFP? Also need to know whether private/VPC deployment options can be covered for the same timeframe.

Appreciate a quick read — procurement is trying to lock vendors by 11/18.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement, Sparrow AI
procurement@sparrow.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. I can move quickly on this, but need internal approvals for credit size and VPC access. Two quick clarifying Qs so I route appropriately:
- Is the 1M token estimate total or per model endpoint?
- Do you need KV/prefix caching persisted across test runs (this impacts infra footprint)?

I will loop in our deals team to approve the credit and confirm whether a short-term private deployment is available for an RFP. If we can’t do a full VPC package in two weeks, we can provide a production-proximate hosted endpoint with an SLA for benchmarking.

I'll follow up with a proposed credit letter + TOS note by end of day Friday (11/12).

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Team — forwarding Sparrow's RFP request (thread above). Key points: 1M tokens (~$12k), two-week dedicated eval, possible short-term VPC. Procurement wants vendor decisions by 11/18.

Ask: Can we approve a promotional credit for an RFP benchmark for Sparrow? Suggested constraints:
- One-time 1M token credit or $12k cap
- Access to hosted endpoint with isolated instance (not full VPC unless infra OK)
- Limited logs (latency and opaque metrics only), no raw customer PII
- Standard credit T&Cs attached, signed by procurement

If we approve, I'll send a formal credit letter + short evaluation guidelines. Sparrow is a mid-market account but this is a competitive RFP — good GTM visibility if we win.

Thanks,
Stephanie

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Stephanie —

We can approve a promotional credit with conditions. Approve up to $10k credits (we should avoid $12k if we can) and hosted isolated endpoint for 2 weeks. VPC/on-prem not feasible in a 2-week window. Conditions:
- Credit expires 30 days after grant
- No PII or raw transcripts delivered; aggregated latency/throughput metrics only
- Procurement must sign our short credit agreement and confirm evaluation scope
- Track sale as a promo in the HubSpot deal (I’ll allocate from promo fund code PROMO-RFP-22)

Monica — assign fulfillment to the trials queue and create a short evaluation instance.

—Marcus
Director, Sales Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Alex —

Thanks for the details over email. Good news: we can offer a promotional credit for the RFP. Outline below — please confirm and we’ll send the signed credit agreement.

Offer summary:
- Promotional credit: $10,000 (applies to tokens/compute)
- Eval window: 2 weeks of isolated hosted endpoint access (not full VPC)
- Metrics: aggregated latency and throughput logs (no PII or raw transcripts)
- Credit expiry: use within 30 days of activation
- Attachments: Redwood credit terms (PDF) and a sample evaluation plan (XLSX)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm scope (1M total tokens or update estimate).
2) Procurement to sign the credit terms (I’ll send DocuSign).
3) Once signed, Monica will provision the instance and share endpoints + credentials.

If this looks good I’ll route the DocuSign and fulfillment today.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sparrow.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sparrow.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sparrow RFP - evaluation credits request

Stephanie / Marcus / Monica —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Sparrow accepts the $10k promotional credit and the hosted isolated endpoint approach. Confirming: the 1M token estimate is a total across the test plan, not per-endpoint. Procurement will sign the DocuSign today.

Attached is our evaluation plan (sparrow_eval_plan_v1.xlsx). Procurement will route the signed credit terms to you; can you confirm you’ll upload the agreement and activation ticket to the HubSpot deal once complete?

If we can get the instance provisioned by 11/18 that meets our vendor shortlisting cadence.

Thanks — Alex
Head of Procurement, Sparrow AI
